positions.title: Independent Music Producer & Artist
positions.description:
Independent music and YouTube project focused on songwriting, production, and digital content creation.
• Write, produce, and publish original English and Vietnamese music projects from concept through final production.
• Create music videos, lyric videos, Shorts, artwork, and other visual content for YouTube.
• Leverage AI-assisted music, vocal, and visual production technologies to develop an end-to-end creative workflow.
• Develop audience, content, and artist-brand strategies across YouTube and digital music platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: Music Production · Songwriting · YouTube · Generative AI · Online Content Creation · Video Production · Artist Development · ChatGPT · Microsoft 365 Copilot · Google Gemini · OpenAI Codex

positions.title: Lead Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical leader for high-visibility monetization and point-of-sale platforms.
•	Led cross-functional collaboration across Product, Marketing, and Data to deliver revenue-driving ad capabilities.
•	Served as Scrum Master and technical lead for ReachPro, a greenfield POS platform, from concept to production.
•	Designed scalable client-side architecture and multi-layer caching strategies to maximize performance and conversion.
•	Championed AI-assisted development (ChatGPT, Claude), establishing patterns that improved engineering throughput by ~2x.
•	Influenced roadmap and architectural standards for front-end platform initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · C# · TypeScript · ChatGPT · Anthropic Claude · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Core

positions.title: Lead Senior Staff Software Engineer

•	Drove architecture and execution for: Campaign management platform; Spreadsheet-based bulk editing system; Budget management UI and productivity tooling.
•	Mentored engineers and influenced frontend engineering standards across teams.
•	Partnered with Product and UX to deliver customer-centric features at scale.

patents.title: Projecting Semantic Information from a Language Independent Syntactic Model
patents.description: Embodiments for the conversion of Computational Independent Model (CIM) rule expressions into semantically non-ambiguous syntax trees are disclosed. In accordance with one embodiment, a method includes analyzing a sentential structure of a Computational Independent Model (CIM) rule expression for clauses. The clauses include at least one expression and at least one rule. The method further includes constructing a semantically non-ambiguous LF syntax tree from the CIM rule expression. The construction being implemented using a logical form (LF) model.
